content.comment_body: Hello, I would like to know if the [product_name] PLC with model number [article_no] supports Modbus TCP/IP. I checked the older manual from 06/2014 with catalogue number [article_no], but Modbus TCP/IP protocol is not listed.
Any [product_name] from the [article_no] series can use MODBUS if the firmware version is [version_no] or later. The newer [product_name] (order number [article_no]) also supports MODBUS.
Refer to this product note: Product innovations for [product_name] ([version_no] firmware). To program MODBUS on [product_name] devices, you need [product_name] [version_no] or newer.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are seeking confirmation regarding Modbus TCP/IP capability for a certain [product_name] model and are encountering outdated documentation and uncertainty about firmware and software compatibility. They value precise details about supported communication protocols and clear guidelines on required versions.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect straightforward information about Modbus TCP/IP support for a particular [product_name] model, including relevant firmware and programming software requirements.
